title: emit-refuses-an-uncleared-crossing
intention: cairn.tools.base.transitions.emit REFUSES a journaled forward crossing that carries no cleared_by and is not on a NAMED exemption roster, so the sentence 'the clearance gate wraps emit' becomes true by physics rather than by prose (Law 4).
why: The lived symptom, in the reader's hands: open cairn/tools/base/transitions.py and four separate places tell you an authority gate stands between a caller and a record of truth. Then any caller imports emit and moves a boat's cursor — which is what all 186 crossings on disk did. Nothing improper was ever authorized, because the box has one owner; what is false is the CLAIM, and a false claim about physics is the most expensive kind, because everything built on top of it assumes the check happened. The harbor's fourth refusal (Unresourced) is built and proven against the real system_rackmount device in both directions, and it has never once fired — not because it is wrong, but because the function it lives in is never called. Wiring resources= is not the missing step; a caller is.
traces_to: Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy)
Law 6 (everything has exactly one owner; the owner alone gates writes)
Law 3 (nothing is known until measured — 0 of 186 is the whole content of this)
Law 9 (red is the default; a component whose falsifier is met reads green because nothing derives red)

falsifier.proves_green: code-seam@v2 gate-set, transcribed. PROVEME (non-skippable): proofs beside the code at cairn/tools/base/proofs/ and cairn/devices/harbor_master/proofs/, run twice, sealed under the tester with isolation='netns' and persisted through validation_store.persist_validation. The Law 8 teeth: (i) a forward journaled crossing with no cleared_by is REFUSED — verified NON-HOLLOW by reverting the check and watching the tooth fail; (ii) a crossing WITH a valid clearance passes and the record on disk carries cleared_by, read back by a separate process; (iii) the bootstrap/exemption roster is READ from a named artifact, and a crossing not on it is refused — a tooth that constructs an off-roster crossing rather than scanning for a conforming one (questions/open-a-scanning-tooth-passes-because-of-the-defect: a scanning tooth passes because of the defect). BUILD GATE: the PROVEME crossing runs build_inspector over cairn/tools/base at its own address. FEEDBACK TO ORIGIN ON FAILURE (Law 3+8 invariant): a red routes back to this ticket and to decisions/2026-08-10-clearance-is-mandatory, because a failure here is evidence about the RULING's cost, which is the one thing Akien priced when he ruled it.
falsifier.proves_red: DONE when a forward journaled crossing carrying no cleared_by is REFUSED by cairn.tools.base.transitions.emit, and the refusal is proven by a tooth that fails if the check is reverted (Law 8, verified by reverting — not assumed), AND at least one real voyage crossing has passed THROUGH clearance and carries cleared_by on disk. RED on any of: (1) the gate is wired but every real crossing takes a named exemption — an exemption roster that grows to cover the fleet is the gate not landing, wearing a roster's clothes; (2) the bootstrap exemption is implicit (an ordering accident) rather than a named, readable entry; (3) clearing becomes ambient — a default actor/owner filled in by the door itself, which would make the authority check vacuous exactly where Law 6 matters (the same two-witness argument that killed auto-inherit for chart claims: a door-minted value can never disagree with the door); (4) clearing a crossing costs more than a file read — correctness bought at a cost that makes crossings unaffordable is the gate failing by another route. CORRECTED 2026-08-10 (see conformance_taken_after_cast): this clause named MethodRegistry, which HAS NOT EXISTED SINCE 2026-08-05. The live mechanism is validation_store.standing(proven_by), one read at an address derived from the proof's own path, so the cost this clause was written against is already gone. What remains measurable, and is what the clause now says: a crossing must not become unaffordable, and the live way that could happen is standing() REFUSING on a stale seal — a component whose code moved under a green seal cannot be cleared onto, which turns an ordinary crossing into a re-seal errand. That is a real red and it is the one to watch; (5) the count of emit-shaped records carrying cleared_by is still ZERO after the ticket proves out. HORIZON: the next 20 journaled crossings after PROVED. If fewer than all 20 carry cleared_by or a NAMED exemption, the gate did not land.
